title: KITCOEK Placement Statistics — Students Placed, Packages, Companies
text:
KITCOEK PLACEMENT STATISTICS — TRAINING AND PLACEMENT CELL

KITCOEK PLACEMENT RECORD (RECENT PLACEMENT SEASON)
- Total students placed: 652 students placed successfully
- Highest salary package offered: Rs. 27.5 LPA (Lakhs Per Annum)
- Average package: approximately Rs. 4.5 to 6 LPA
- Total companies visited campus for recruitment drives: 157 companies

TOP RECRUITERS AND COMPANIES
The following companies have recruited KITCOEK students:
KPIT Technologies, Wipro, Wipro PARI Private Limited, Adani Electricity Mumbai, Adani Group, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Infosys, Cognizant, Larsen & Toubro (L&T), Persistent Systems, Mahindra, Bosch, Cummins, Forbes Marshall, Kirloskar, Bajaj Auto, Thermax, Emcure Pharmaceuticals, Bharat Forge, Tata Motors, Finolex, Zensar Technologies, Tech Mahindra, Capgemini, and many more industry leaders.

T&P CELL ACTIVITIES
The Training and Placement (T&P) Cell / TNP Cell at KITCOEK:
- Operates round the year to facilitate contacts between companies and students
- Conducts pre-placement training: aptitude, group discussion, technical interviews, soft skills
- Organizes mock interviews and resume-writing workshops
- Facilitates summer internships and industrial training
- Coordinates campus recruitment drives throughout the academic year
- Maintains active industry connections for off-campus placements

CONTACT TNP CELL
Email: tnp@kitcoek.in
Website: https://www.kitcoek.in/tnp

NOTE
Placement figures are from the most recent placement season. Statistics change each year as new batches graduate. For the latest figures, contact the T&P Cell directly.
